mechanism: RL-trained agent that re-weights data domain mixtures during continual pre-training
evidence_scope: The agent learns generalizable heuristics through reinforcement learning on large quantities of data mixing trajectories with corresponding feedback from an evaluation environment.
evidence_role: we prove that more general heuristics can be parameterized by proposing Data Mixing Agent, the first model-based, end-to-end framework that learns to re-weight domains.
